name: stakedXYM
title: The Silent Echo of Muir Glacier
tagline: A friendly spirit born in March remains still since its final call.

chapters.heading: The birth of stakedXYM
paragraphs: A flickering light reveals the origin of stakedXYM. It arrived on March 11, 2021. A wallet ending in 09ed brought it into the world. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book.
The contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum. It appeared during the Muir Glacier era. It was built using Solidity 0.6.8. Now it sits at about 5.6 years old.

chapters.heading: The quiet pulse of stakedXYM
paragraphs: The contract lived a quiet life. It saw 60 transactions move through its gates. People used it to mint, burn, and transfer. They also used approve to give it permission.
It was active in 2 different years between 2021 and 2022. The busy days passed like shadows. Now it sits still on the chain.

chapters.heading: The long silence
paragraphs: The contract sits still under the moonlight. Its last call was the approve function on July 18, 2022. It has been quiet for 4.3 years.
The code still rests on the chain like a shadow. It holds 0.0 ETH inside. No one has reached out to it since that summer day.
